title: Paper Mario - Over Shiver Mountain
description:
From Paper Mario N64.

Would be very good for ice, cloud/sky, or calmer levels.

This is my first one of these. I am a composer and love video games so I thought I'd try this out.

EDIT1: Changed channel 1 to bring out a more percussive texture.
EDIT2: Changed channel 5 and 6 by making them louder.
